title: 2027 Graduate Automation Engineer

It doesn’t stop there. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute. **We offer some fantastic benefits including:** * **Biannual salary reviews:** We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. title: Clinical Research Assistant
description: Nuritas is a pioneering biotechnology company combining artificial intelligence, genomics and peptide science to discover and develop natural bioactive ingredients with clinically relevant health benefits. Our mission is to improve the lives of billions of people by unlocking the power of peptides and bringing scientifically validated ingredients into everyday products. We work at the intersection of discovery science, clinical evidence, nutrition and commercial application translating deep scientific insight into products that can create real\-world impact. As we continue to scale our clinical evidence base and ingredient pipeline, we are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Clinical Research Assistant** to join our R\&D team. **The Role** This is an exciting opportunity for an early\-career scientist to gain hands\-on experience in clinical research operations, nutrition science and R\&D within a dynamic, fast\-growing biotechnology company. You will work closely with, and in direct support of, the Head of Clinical Trials, contributing to a broad range of activities across project coordination, scientific documentation, clinical administration and research support. This is a support\-focused role that requires strong attention to detail, good organisational skills and a proactive approach. No two days will look the same, and you will have the opportunity to develop your skills across multiple areas of clinical research and applied nutrition science. Due to the nature of the role it will be based on\-site at our office and lab on Dawson St. **What You’ll Do** * Participate in relevant R\&D activities, meetings and discussions to build understanding of the clinical and ingredient development pipeline. * Assist with the preparation, formatting and proofreading of clinical documentation, including protocols, ethics submissions, clinical study reports and supporting materials. * Support the conduct of in\-house case studies, including participant coordination, data collection, documentation and follow\-up. * Assist with literature reviews to support clinical projects, ingredient development and scientific substantiation. * Support data entry, basic data organisation and review of research outputs where required. * Support clinical material logistics and coordinate scheduling activities, internal meetings, external partner discussions and CRO communications. * Help ensure documentation, trackers and project tools are kept accurate, current and accessible. * Contribute to process improvement by identifying opportunities to make clinical administration and coordination more efficient. * Support a high\-quality, organised and collaborative working environment within the R\&D team. * Take meeting notes, track actions and follow up on agreed deliverables; keeping internal project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana or equivalent systems up to date. * Support coordination between internal teams and external providers to help ensure clinical activities remain on track. **What You’ll Bring** * MSc in Nutrition, Biology, Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline, with at least 1 years’ relevant professional experience in clinical research, food industry project management, nutrition science or a related environment. * Eagerness to learn and develop across clinical research, nutrition science and R\&D activities. * Interest or experience in nutraceuticals, functional foods, dietary supplements, health ingredients or nutrition science. * Ability to work collaboratively in a small, fast\-paced and evolving environment. * Comfortable working primarily on\-site as part of a hands\-on R\&D team. * Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, particularly in documentation, proofreading and record\-keeping. * Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing tasks and deadlines. * Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. * A proactive, self\-starter mindset, with the confidence to ask questions, follow up and look for ways to contribute. **Nuritas Values** At Nuritas, how we work matters as much as what we deliver. The successful candidate will demonstrate: * **Integrity** — maintaining accuracy, confidentiality and high standards in all clinical and scientific documentation. * **Ambition** — showing motivation to learn, develop and contribute to meaningful scientific work. * **Innovation** — bringing curiosity and openness to new ideas, tools and ways of working. * **Collaboration** — working effectively with colleagues across R\&D, Clinical, Commercial and Operations. * **Adaptability** — responding positively to changing priorities in a fast\-moving environment. **Benefits** * Modern City Centre Location * Employee Assistance Program * Health Insurance * Pension Scheme *Nuritas is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome people who bring scientific excellence, curiosity and collaboration to our mission of improving lives through breakthrough peptide science.*

description: **About the role** The Commercial Graduate Programme includes two placements: Stretch Placement: A role outside your academic discipline that broadens your commercial awareness and develops new skills Core Placement: A role aligned to your interests and career aspirations within the Commercial function Each placement is structured around clear objectives and business outcomes, allowing you to make a visible impact while building your professional experience. Throughout the programme, you'll gain exposure to a variety of commercial disciplines, which may include: Buying and Category Management Product development and innovation Supplier and stakeholder relationship management Space, range, and merchandising planning Pricing, promotions, and profitability analysis Customer insight and market trends Supply chain and stock planning Sustainability and responsible sourcing initiatives You'll work with internal teams and external suppliers, analyse data to support decision\-making, and help deliver products and propositions that meet the needs of our customers. By the end of the programme, you'll have developed a strong understanding of how commercial decisions drive business performance, customer satisfaction, and long\-term growth, preparing you for a successful career within Tesco Ireland. Salary: €35,000 Start date: 6 September 2027 **You will be responsible for** Alongside your day\-to\-day responsibilities, you'll take part in a structured 18\-month development programme that includes: Upskilling workshops focused on commercial, retail, and business skills Personal development sessions to build confidence, resilience, and leadership capability Store visits and supplier experiences to deepen your understanding of the customer and the retail landscape Networking opportunities with graduates, senior leaders, and colleagues across Tesco Ireland Mentoring and coaching from experienced professionals who will support your growth and development At Tesco, graduates are given meaningful responsibility from the start, supported by a strong network of colleagues who are invested in helping you succeed. **You will need** A genuine curiosity and desire to learn, develop and grow both personally and professionally. A positive and adaptable mindset, with the ability to embrace change and approach challenges as opportunities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to share ideas and ask questions. A collaborative approach and a willingness to work effectively as part of a team. Good organisation skills and the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines. Enthusiasm, initiative, and a proactive attitude towards learning and problem\-solving. A strong team spirit, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive working environment. **Whats in it for you?** Our Commercial Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are curious about customers, passionate about products, and excited by the fast\-paced world of retail. From day one, you'll join one of the most dynamic areas of the business, helping shape the products our customers buy every day while gaining exposure to how a leading retailer operates. You'll work alongside experienced commercial teams and contribute to real business challenges across areas such as Buying, Category Management, Supply Chain, Product Development, Customer Insight, and Strategy. Your ideas and contributions will help influence decisions that impact millions of customer interactions each year. Annual Leave: Starting at 23 days per annum **About Us** Our core purpose, "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day" means we always keep customers at the heart of what we do, while also reflecting our responsibilities to the communities we serve and to society more broadly. title: Customer Graduate Programme - Tesco Ireland
description: **About the role** The Customer Graduate Programme includes two placements: Stretch Placement: A role outside your academic background that broadens your commercial understanding and develops new skills Core Placement: A role aligned to your interests within the Customer function, allowing you to build expertise and make a meaningful impact Each placement is structured around clear objectives and measurable outcomes, ensuring you can track your development while contributing to key business priorities. Throughout the programme, you'll gain exposure to a variety of customer\-focused areas, including: Customer Insight and Analytics Clubcard and Loyalty Programmes Customer Experience and Service Improvement Customer Strategy and Planning Digital Customer Journeys Customer Communications and Engagement Market Research and Customer Trends Customer\-Focused Innovation Projects You’ll work with cross\-functional teams to understand customer needs, analyse customer feedback and data, identify opportunities for improvement, and help deliver initiatives that enhance the overall customer experience. By the end of the programme, you'll have developed a deep understanding of how customer\-led decisions drive business growth, build loyalty, and support Tesco’s purpose of serving customers, communities, and the planet a little better every day. Salary: €35,000 Programme start date: 6 September 2027 **You will be responsible for** Alongside your day\-to\-day responsibilities, you’ll take part in a structured 18\-month development programme that includes: Upskilling workshops focused on customer insight, retail operations, and business strategy Personal development sessions to build confidence, communication, and leadership skills Store visits and customer immersion experiences to understand our customers firsthand Networking opportunities with graduates and leaders across the business Mentoring and coaching from experienced colleagues who will support your development throughout the programme At Tesco, graduates are given meaningful responsibility from the start, supported by a strong network of colleagues who are committed to helping you succeed. **You will need** A genuine curiosity and desire to learn, develop and grow both personally and professionally. An interest in customers, marketing, brands and understanding what drives customer behaviour. A positive and adaptable mindset, with the ability to embrace change and approach challenges as opportunities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to share ideas and ask questions. A collaborative approach and a willingness to work effectively as part of a team. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with an interest in using data and insights to support decision\-making. A strong team spirit, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive working environment. **Whats in it for you?** Our Customer Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are passionate about understanding customers and creating outstanding experiences. If you’re curious about customer behaviour, enjoy solving problems, and want to make a real difference to how customers interact with Tesco, this programme will give you the opportunity to build a rewarding career in one of the most customer\-focused retail businesses in Ireland. From day one, you’ll be part of a collaborative team working on initiatives that help us better understand our customers, improve their shopping experience, and strengthen customer loyalty. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that influence how we engage with customers across stores, online, and through our Clubcard programme. Annual Leave: Starting at 23 days per annum **About Us** Our core purpose, "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day" means we always keep customers at the heart of what we do, while also reflecting our responsibilities to the communities we serve and to society more broadly. At Tesco, inclusion means that Everyone’s Welcome. Everyone is treated fairly and with respect; by valuing individuality and uniqueness we create a sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion have always been at the heart of Tesco. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. Across the Tesco group we are building an inclusive workplace, a place to actively celebrate the cultures, personalities and preferences of our colleagues – who in turn help to build the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. Our office is based in Dun Laoghaire, Co. Dublin and Tesco has embraced hybrid working. We have open plan offices and informal breakout spaces so teams can collaborate together. We’ve a subsidised colleague restaurant for all breakfast, lunch and snack requirements. At the weekly “Team 5” update you'll get to hear about exciting events happening across our stores and any important business updates. We have stunning views of Dublin Bay from our office and are ideally located next to public transport options and lots of handy amenities in the local area.

description: We are looking for a Project Quality Engineer to support quality control across the construction and delivery phase of data center projects. This role is responsible for construction quality planning, on\-site inspections, non\-conformance management, contractor and supplier quality oversight, stage acceptance, and quality documentation to ensure project delivery meets customer requirements, applicable standards, and company quality expectations. You will work closely with project and site teams while maintaining independent professional judgment on quality matters. **Responsibilities** * Support project quality planning, including preparation of Inspection and Test Plans (ITP), quality control points, and stage acceptance criteria. * Conduct incoming inspections for equipment and materials, routine site inspections, and witness inspections for critical construction activities. * Oversee quality control across electrical, HVAC, fire protection, ELV, and building automation systems. * Issue and manage Non\-Conformance Reports (NCR), lead and suppliers, and track improvement actions. * Organize or participate in stage acceptance activities, including concealed works inspection, process acceptance, and sectional/subsection acceptance. * project delivery and continuous improvement. * Support quality witness activities during relevant commissioning and testing stages where required. **Job Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical \& Electrical Engineering, HVAC, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline. * 3–5 years of experience in quality management, technical engineering, or site quality control in data centers, industrial MEP projects, power engineering, or related environments. * Good understanding of MEP construction practices, installation methods, inspection requirements, and acceptance standards. * Ability to read MEP drawings and understand system logic across electrical, HVAC, fire protection, and ELV/BA systems. * Familiarity with quality systems and tools such as ISO 9001, ITP, NCR, 8D, and 5\-Why. * Strong communication, coordination, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively on site for extended periods. * Bilingual or multilingual proficiency is preferred, with proficiency in Chinese considered a strong advantage. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in data center or mission\-critical project quality management. * Familiarity with standards such as GB 50174, Uptime Tier, or equivalent industry practices. * Exposure to FAT, on\-site commissioning, or Integrated Systems Testing (IST) quality witness activities. * Relevant certifications in quality management, ISO auditing, construction, or project delivery. What You’ll Bring A strong sense of ownership, sound technical judgment, and the ability to uphold quality standards in a fast\-paced project environment.

title: Graduate Programme 2027
description: **For the Public Good** At Central Bank of Ireland, you will get the opportunity to join an organisation at the heart of the economy and financial system, with a focus on doing meaningful work for the public good whilst striving to have a positive impact on society. Our Graduate Programme develops the future talent and leadership that will allow the Central Bank to continue to achieve its mandate now and into the future. When you join our Graduate Programme, your career and development will be our priority. Over the course of the programme, we will nurture and develop you whilst providing you with the opportunity to: Contribute to and deliver meaningful work that matters – the work that we carry out every day is in the best interest of the public * Benefit from a panoramic view of the financial system * Gain a comprehensive understanding of Ireland's financial system and Central Bank's role within it * Achieve your personal and professional goals. **Our Programme** Our three\-year Graduate Programme will allow you to experience the diverse and unique work we’re involved in.* You’ll be able to make a difference by participating in activities like contributing to the development of policies, procedures and frameworks, such as how we regulate firms or how we run our organisation, assisting in the supervision of financial institutions or supporting the screening and transmission of data to aid this supervision and reporting. * Leveraging your curiosity and critical thinking skills to identify and drive continuous improvement. * Providing solutions, underpinned by research and analysis, to complex problems that are unique to working at the Central Bank. * Undertaking tailored training whilst developing and enhancing your technical and soft skills across a range of areas During the programme, you'll undertake two rotations. This will accelerate your development and allow you to improve your technical and interpersonal skills through meaningful work on real challenges. At the Central Bank, attitude is every bit as important as ability. You will have every opportunity to develop if you are a team player, have passion for what you do and have a desire to continuously improve. If you love to learn and really want to contribute to working for the public good, you'll feel at home from day one. We're looking for graduates with:* Drive and motivation: you take initiative and follow through on commitments * Curiosity and adaptability: you're open to learning and responsive to change * Strong collaboration skills: you work effectively in teams and contribute positively * Independent thinking: you're prepared to question assumptions and bring fresh perspectives * Academic achievement: a 2\.1 or above in any degree discipline **Our Programme Streams** When you apply for the programme, you can choose a specific stream to specialise in: **AI, Analytics \& Data** If you're passionate about using AI, analytics and data whilst working for the public good, we encourage you to select the AI, Analytics and Data stream. You'll be involved in:* Collecting and maintaining data for statistical and supervisory purposes * Helping us to build and maintain our data infrastructure * Using data analytics and visualisations to provide insights from financial and economic data * Compiling data and preparing early\-stage analysis, literature searches and reviews on research topics for economists and policy specialists For this stream, we are particularly interested in graduates with backgrounds in AI, computer science, statistics, economics, econometrics, data analysis, information technology, mathematics, cognitive science or other quantitative related disciplines. **Supervision, Policy and Risk** If your application for this stream is successful, you will be working across a range of business areas and getting involved in diverse activities such as:* Supporting the supervision of financial institutions * Contributing to policy development and implementation * Advancing your expertise in financial and non\-financial risk * Analysing emerging trends to identify and mitigate risk For this stream, we are particularly interested in graduates with backgrounds in business, finance, legal, policy, engineering or related disciplines. **Actuarial** In this stream, you will work within our Insurance and Prudential Analysis and Inspections directorates, and play a key role in:* Contributing actuarial analysis and subject matter expertise to deliver effective supervision of regulated entities in the insurance sector, leading to a more robust and resilient financial system * Analysing insurance industry data to contribute to the monitoring and assessment of reserving, pricing and capital risks across life, non\-life and reinsurance markets. * Assessing and monitoring of complex internal capital models, whilst working closely with other European regulators. * Collaborating with colleagues across the supervisory, policy, consumer and analytics teams to support their understanding of actuarial information. For this stream, we offer unique opportunities for trainee actuaries to build actuarial experience across a variety of actuarial disciplines and a broad range of domestic and international insurance business models. We are particularly interested in graduates with backgrounds in mathematical\-based disciplines who want to build their actuarial career and qualifications with us. At the Central Bank, we offer a learning environment with strong academic supports to pursue actuarial qualifications. We know it's our people who make the Central Bank special and we are focused on creating a diverse, inclusive, fulfilling and progressive work environment. We encourage applications from candidates with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives as it strengthens us, as individuals and as an organisation. title: Junior IT Security Analyst
description: We are a Site Intelligence company transforming how industrial businesses operate. Our platform turns your existing infrastructure into a source of actionable operational intelligence, enabling teams to see what's happening, understand why, and improve continuously. By surfacing the operational signals that reports miss, we help the world's largest logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing operators stay one step ahead, making operations visible and driving proactive safety. We're a fast\-growing, high\-agency team building category\-defining products by leveraging the latest technologies in computer vision and AI. Industry leaders like DHL, Amazon, and Tesla trust Protex AI to drive measurable safety improvements, achieving an average 64% risk reduction within just three months of deployment. Operating in 20\+ countries, Protex is the go\-to safety partner for Fortune 500 manufacturing and logistics enterprises, transforming workplace safety with real\-time, AI\-powered insights. **Role Overview** ----------------- The IT Security Analyst will be a critical, hands\-on resource responsible for the daily operations and administration of Protex AI's internal IT environment and core security tooling. Reporting to the Head of Security, Risk \& Compliance, this role's primary mission is to provide support for day\-to\-day IT operations, and to support the advancement of our strategic compliance initiatives (ISO 27001 certification maintenance, SOC 2 Type I audit readiness targeting completion in 2026, and preparation for ISO 42001\). The ideal candidate is a highly organised and technically curious individual, ready to take ownership of vital operational processes in a high\-growth environment. This is an exciting entry level role which will give a recent graduate experience of an IT Security function in a fast\-scaling start up. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ The IT Security Analyst will manage the operational security and IT needs, ensuring efficiency and control across the organization: * **User Lifecycle Management:** Assist with the entire employee lifecycle, including timely and secure provisioning and de\-provisioning of systems access, network access, and end\-user equipment. * **Device \& Asset Management:** Configure, provision, and de\-provision employee laptops to security baselines. Maintain and update the hardware and software asset inventory to ensure licensing and compliance. * **Security Monitoring \& Triage:** Monitor and perform initial triage of security alerts, logs and dashboards from various tools, for escalation to the Head of Security. * **Vulnerability Support:** Conduct initial assessment and triage of vulnerability scanning tool findings across applications and infrastructure, supporting the vulnerability management program. * **GRC and Compliance Support:** Assist the Head of Security in gathering, documenting, and organising evidence required for external audits \- including Protex AI's first SOC 2 Type I audit, and ongoing ISO 27001 certification maintenance \- as well as assisting in the implementation of other key compliance initiatives. * **Vendor \& Third\-Party Risk Support:** Conduct initial security and data processing agreement (DPA) reviews of third\-party vendors, escalating risk findings to the Head of Security. * **Client Assurance Support:** Be the internal point of contact for client security due diligence questionnaires. * **Tooling Implementation:** Assist with the deployment, configuration, and integration of operational security solutions (e.g., VPN, EDR, DLP, MDM). * **Secure Business Enablement:** Support business units in securely configuring newly acquired software and setting up third\-party integrations, ensuring new tools meet Protex AI's security baseline before go\-live. * **Process Automation:** Improve the efficiency of current internal IT Security operations. * **Helpdesk \& Triage (L1/L2\):** Serve as the first point of contact for day\-to\-day operational issues, including password resets, access issues, and basic troubleshooting, minimising employee downtime. **Requirements** ---------------- * **Experience \& Education:** A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field. This is an entry\-level position; graduate candidates are welcome. * **Technical Aptitude:** Foundational understanding of core IT operations, networking concepts, and operating systems (macOS and Windows). * **Service \& Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong focus on customer service and empathy for end\-users. * **Organisational Skills:** Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous tasks, prioritise effectively, and maintain meticulous documentation. Proactive and self\-motivated by nature, a "doer". * **Security Curiosity:** A demonstrated, self\-driven interest in the cybersecurity landscape, risk management, or regulatory compliance frameworks. * **Cloud Service Providers:** Familiarity with AWS and their services. **Desirable Skills (a plus)** ----------------------------- * Familiarity with modern Identity Providers (IdP) like Okta, Azure AD, or Google Workspace. * Adept at using AI tools to automate processes and repetitive tasks. * Basic scripting skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for process automation. **Please note:** we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Additionally, the successful candidate will be required to be in our Dublin office on Westland Row at least two days per week. Protex AI is an inclusive and equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating an equitable workplace for everyone regardless of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Met us at NIBRT? Start your career in Medical Information with ProPharma

All applications will be treated on their own merit and candidates will not be at any advantage or disadvantage based on their proximity to an office. \*\*\*ProPharma Group does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters/third parties. Please, no phone calls or emails to anyone regarding this posting.\*\*\*

title: New Business Account Executive (Baltic Market)
description: **About Revolut** People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80\+ million customers get more from their money every day. LinkedIn outreach) * A keen interest in launching a career in a high\-performing sales culture * Proven determination and accountability to succeed in a fast\-paced environment * A willingness to * Effective time management and organisation skills to balance customer engagement, deal closing, and CRM administration **Nice to have** * A degree in finance or a business\-related subject * An entrepreneurial, problem\-solving mindset * To be a deal closer with a creative and innovative attitude * Experience in a reputable startup * Impressive cross\-functional project management skills * To be comfortable in a complex selling environment with the ability to communicate with decision makers at many levels Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D\&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. description: **Job Title: OSS Sales Executive** **About Us Activ8 Energies** Activ8 Energies are actively seeking a One Stop Shop Sales Executive to join our One Stop Shop Department. As a One\-Stop\-Shop (OSS) Sales Executive, you will act as a dedicated sales\-focused point of contact for homeowners progressing through the One Stop Shop Grant journey. This is a hybrid position based out of our Naas, Co, Kildare location. At Activ8 we're dedicated to empowering homeowners and businesses towards self\-sustainability through exceptional customer experiences and innovative products. compliant, competitive, and maximised for grant support. **Responsibilities Include** * Engage with qualified leads and existing customers, delivering a professional and consultative sales experience. technical and financial benefits, and explain grant eligibility and funding options clearly. * Act as the customer’s single point of contact during the sales process, managing their journey from achieving sales targets. * Ability to work well in a team environment and collaborate with cross\-functional departments. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Knowledge of solar technology, renewable energy incentives, and financing options is desirable. * Previous experience in managing and closing deals within a B2C environment would be an advantage. * Technical knowledge related to solar energy system designs \& heat pumps is a plus. * Familiarity with Salesforce an advantage but not necessary. **Our Benefits** * Competitive Salary * Commission Structure * Company Pension. * Private medical insurance. * Bike to work scheme. * Employee assistance program. * Holiday Plus * Gym membership. * On\-site parking. * Breakfast Club. **How To Apply** Interested in making a difference in renewable energy? Apply through the link provided. *Activ8 Solar Energies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

title: Online Graduate Programme - Tesco Ireland

title: Sustainability Graduate Scheme - Tesco Ireland
description: **About the role** The Sustainability Graduate Programme includes two placements: Stretch Placement: A role outside your academic background that broadens your understanding of the wider business and develops new skills Core Placement: A role aligned to your interests within Sustainability, allowing you to develop specialist knowledge and contribute to key sustainability priorities Each placement is structured around clear objectives and measurable outcomes, giving you the opportunity to make a tangible impact while developing a broad understanding of sustainable business practices. Throughout the programme, you'll gain exposure to a variety of sustainability\-focused areas, including: Environmental Sustainability and Climate Action Sustainable Packaging and Waste Reduction Responsible Sourcing and Supply Chain Sustainability Community and Social Impact Programmes Food Waste Reduction Initiatives Sustainable Operations and Resource Efficiency ESG Reporting and Performance Measurement Colleague and Customer Sustainability Engagement You'll work with teams across the business to support sustainability projects, analyse performance data, identify opportunities for improvement, and help deliver initiatives that support Tesco’s long\-term sustainability commitments. By the end of the programme, you'll have developed a strong understanding of how sustainability is integrated into a large retail business, how responsible business practices create value for customers and communities, and how you can help deliver positive change that supports Tesco’s purpose of serving our customers, communities, and planet a little better every day. Salary: €35,000 Programme start date: 6 September 2027 **You will be responsible for** Alongside your day\-to\-day responsibilities, you’ll take part in a structured 18\-month development programme that includes: Upskilling workshops focused on sustainability, ESG, project management, and business strategy Personal development sessions to build your confidence, communication, and leadership skills Visits to stores, suppliers, and community initiatives to see sustainability in action Networking opportunities with graduates and leaders across the business Mentoring and coaching from experienced colleagues who are passionate about developing future talent At Tesco, graduates are given meaningful responsibility from the start, supported by a strong network of colleagues who are invested in helping them succeed and grow. **You will need** Our Sustainability Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are passionate about creating a better future for people, communities, and the planet. If you're motivated by environmental and social impact and want to help shape the future of sustainable retail, this programme will give you the opportunity to make a real difference while building a rewarding career. **Whats in it for you?** From day one, you'll join a team that is focused on driving Tesco’s sustainability ambitions across our business. You'll contribute to projects that support our goals around reducing environmental impact, supporting responsible sourcing, reducing food waste, promoting healthier choices, and creating positive change in the communities we serve. You'll work with colleagues across multiple functions, gaining exposure to how sustainability is embedded into decision\-making and helping to deliver initiatives that make a meaningful impact for customers, colleagues, suppliers, and the environment. Annual Leave: Starting at 23 days per annum **About Us** Our core purpose, "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day" means we always keep customers at the heart of what we do, while also reflecting our responsibilities to the communities we serve and to society more broadly. At Tesco, inclusion means that Everyone’s Welcome. Everyone is treated fairly and with respect; by valuing individuality and uniqueness we create a sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion have always been at the heart of Tesco. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. Across the Tesco group we are building an inclusive workplace, a place to actively celebrate the cultures, personalities and preferences of our colleagues – who in turn help to build the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. Our office is based in Dun Laoghaire, Co. Dublin and Tesco has embraced hybrid working. We have open plan offices and informal breakout spaces so teams can collaborate together. We’ve a subsidised colleague restaurant for all breakfast, lunch and snack requirements. At the weekly “Team 5” update you'll get to hear about exciting events happening across our stores and any important business updates. We have stunning views of Dublin Bay from our office and are ideally located next to public transport options and lots of handy amenities in the local area.

title: Event Executive | Global Events
description: **We are looking for someone who wants to build a career in global events and get stuck into making them happen.** You will be part of the team bringing complex corporate events to life, learning how all the pieces fit together and taking on more responsibility as your experience grows. You take pride in getting the small things right because you understand that they make a difference to the bigger picture. Being a team of 5 means you will know the people you work with. You will know your clients.
